text:
Maya: quick sync — customer-facing ask: standardize request/response token fields + trace ids across chat/completions/embeddings. Need to decide naming, required vs opt-in, and launch criteria for next sprint.
Alex: what's the main customer ask? specific fields?
Maya: they want: 1) a token usage breakdown (request/response/total) 2) a single trace id that ties client -> infra -> model logs 3) stable field names so SDKs can parse without per-model hacks
Sam: +1. Also we need to consider cost visibility: customers want per-call token counts for billing/alerts.
Jordan: Launch criteria proposal: (a) backward compatible default (no breaking changes), (b) new fields added under top-level `meta` object, (c) docs + SDK bump, (d) canary traffic and perf guardrails.
Alex: I think nesting under `meta` is safer. Suggest names: `meta.token_counts.request`, `meta.token_counts.response`, `meta.token_counts.total`.
Sam: prefer shorter names to match existing usage elsewhere. How about `meta.tokens.request`, `meta.tokens.response`, `meta.tokens.total`? keeps payload small.
Maya: consumers asked for explicit per-token subtotals (prompt, completion, tool-calls). So maybe `meta.tokens.prompt`, `meta.tokens.completion`, `meta.tokens.tool_calls`.
Jordan: we should also standardize integer vs object. Make counts integers and add an optional `meta.usage` for token-based pricing details.
Alex: trace id naming: teams suggested `x-ri-trace` or `ri_trace_id`. Any preferences?
Sam: For downstream log correlation, prefer HTTP header style `X-RI-Trace-Id` for transport, and `meta.trace.id` in body. Keeps both worlds.
Maya: agree. Proposal: add header `X-RI-Trace-Id` (optional to provide) and service will echo `meta.trace.id` in response. If header missing, service will generate one and return it.
Alex: OK. What about sampling/PII? trace id should be random UUIDv4, no sensitive info.
Jordan: can we set rollout gating: must pass canary 99.9% echo correctness and no >5% increase in p95 latency.
Maya: yes. Docs callouts: migration guide showing how to read fields and fallback if missing. Also add `meta.beta` boolean for early adopters if we want an opt-in.
Sam: function-calling structured outputs: need to ensure `meta` doesn't conflict with function result schema. Suggest `meta._redwood` to avoid collisions.
Alex: hmm collisions are real. But `_redwood` prefix might feel hacky. Alternative: `redwood_meta` top-level. Thoughts?
Jordan: prefer `meta.redwood` nested under `meta`. e.g., `meta.redwood.trace.id` and `meta.redwood.tokens` so it's namespaced.
Maya: agree on `meta.redwood.*`. Keeps `meta` generic but namespaced. Update names: `meta.redwood.tokens.prompt`, `meta.redwood.tokens.completion`, `meta.redwood.tokens.total`, and `meta.redwood.trace.id`.
Sam: sample response payload suggestion:
```
{
  "id": "abc123",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "choices": [...],
  "meta": {
    "redwood": {
      "trace": {"id": "6f47a4d2-..."},
      "tokens": {"prompt": 45, "completion": 120, "total": 165}
    }
  }
}
```
Alex: works. Also include `meta.redwood.usage_type` string for `billing` vs `internal` so downstream can pick display logic.
Maya: good. Now backward compatibility: if `meta.redwood` absent, SDKs should fall back to existing `usage` object when present. We must add shim in server that populates `meta.redwood` from legacy `usage` for one major version period.
Jordan: launch checklist items: API change doc, SDK patches (JS/Python/Go), unit tests, canary config, perf test results, customer comms + migration guide.
Sam: I'll take SDK PRs. Alex will own server shim + generation of `X-RI-Trace-Id`.
Alex: noted. I'll also add flag `enable_meta_redwood` default off for orgs during first week, with rollout toggles.
Maya: product acceptance: have 2 customers validate token fields + trace id and confirm billing mapping for tokens. Also no regressions in cost reporting.
Jordan: timeline: spec freeze by EOD Friday, eng implementation next 2 sprints, canary in sprint 3, GA after successful canary and docs.
Maya: final call: settle on `meta.redwood` naming and `X-RI-Trace-Id` header. If no objections by 12:00 tomorrow we'll freeze.
Alex: :thumbsup: 
Sam: :+1: 
Jordan: :thinking_face: I want the shim timeframe documented — I'll add that to the spec doc.
infra-bot: deploy/ci passed for branch "meta-redwood-spec" :white_check_mark:
Maya: thanks — I'll update the spec doc and add the sample payload + migration steps.
